title: TriSegAgent: Context-Efficient 3D Annotation with MLLMs via Tri-Planes
abstract: arXiv:2611.30240v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interactive segmentation models turn a few clicks into a segmentation prediction across domains, so annotators only decide where the prediction still needs correction. Annotation thus becomes a loop of inspecting the prediction and clicking again. Each step of this loop is a visual judgment, which suits general-purpose multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents. In this work, we focus on letting these agents run this loop on 3D volumes. However, the MLLM in such an agent takes only 2D images as input, so the agent must observe the 3D volume in 2D. Since the loop calls the MLLM many times, this observation must be token-compact enough to keep every call cheap, yet informative enough to show error regions in the 3D prediction. translated_title: TriSegAgent：基于三平面实现上下文高效的多模态大语言模型3D标注
translated_abstract: 交互式分割模型能够跨领域将几次点击转化为分割预测，因此标注者只需判断预测在哪些位置仍需修正。标注由此变成了一个“检查预测—再次点击”的循环。这一循环的每一步本质上都是视觉判断，恰好适合由通用的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）智能体来执行。在本工作中，我们专注于让这类智能体在3D体数据上运行该标注循环。然而，此类智能体中的MLLM仅接受2D图像作为输入，因此智能体必须以2D方式观察3D体数据。由于该循环会多次调用MLLM，这种观察必须在token数量上足够紧凑，以保持每次调用的低成本，同时又需包含足够信息以展示3D预测中的错误区域。我们利用三平面——即在体数据中相交于一点的三张正交平面——来同时满足这两个需求。我们从理论和实验上均证明了，三平面具有上下文高效性，同时能保留足够的细节。
tldr: 本文提出TriSegAgent，通过在3D体数据中相交于一点的三张正交平面作为紧凑且信息丰富的2D观察方式，使多模态大语言模型智能体能够低成本、高保真地执行交互式3D分割标注循环。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TriSegAgent, which employs tri-planes—three orthogonal planes intersecting at a single point in a 3D volume—as a token-compact yet informative 2D observation, enabling MLLM agents to perform interactive 3D annotation loops efficiently.
